name: right-motion-drawer
title: Right Motion Drawer
blurb: Navigation drawer slides in from the right edge.
description: A pre-configured motion drawer coming from the right side with default theme colors. Toggle button stays in place while drawer animates. Ready to drop in with navigation content.
use_when: You need a right-aligned navigation drawer without tuning direction or animations.
avoid_when: Your design requires custom widths or animation timing.
a11y: Click to open, overlay click or drag to close. No additional focus management beyond base drawer.
